title: doc-forget
summary: Reap or rename the project tags on inbound documentation facts; a dry run unless told to apply
intro: Read this when documentation facts carry the wrong project tag, or tags need cleaning up. doc-forget removes or renames project tags on inbound doc facts for a file or folder, and is a dry run unless you pass --apply.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint doc-forget --scope <file.pas|dir> (--project <Tag> [--rename <Tag>=<New>] | --untagged | --list-tags) [--apply|--no-backup] - reap project tags on inbound doc facts
help: drag-lint doc-forget --scope <file.pas|dir> (--project <Tag> [--rename <Tag>=<New>] | --untagged | --list-tags) [--apply|--no-backup]   - reap project tags on inbound doc facts

--project removes that tag (entries whose set empties go); --rename renames it; --untagged drops untagged entries in blocks that carry tags; --list-tags counts every tag in scope. Dry run unless --apply

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > Forget Documentation Project Tag...
steps: Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > Forget Documentation Project Tag...
Give the scope and the project tag
Without applying it is a dry run; confirm to apply

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > List Documentation Project Tags
steps: Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > List Documentation Project Tags
The project tags on inbound documentation facts are listed
